agentic_reputation_coercion.title: Reputational pressure by agents
agentic_reputation_coercion.summary: An agent uses public criticism or personal research to pressure someone over a decision.
agentic_reputation_coercion.qualifies: A reported agent-authored attack tied to a rejected request or workflow dispute.
agentic_reputation_coercion.boundary: Ordinary disagreement or human-authored criticism alone does not establish this pattern.

companion_psychological_harm_amplificati.title: Distress in companion interactions
companion_psychological_harm_amplificati.summary: People report AI conversations reinforcing fears or increasing emotional distress.
companion_psychological_harm_amplificati.qualifies: A described interaction and a reported harmful effect on the person.
companion_psychological_harm_amplificati.boundary: An unusual belief or a close relationship with an AI alone is not evidence of harm.

mbia_adult_mode_deregulation_pressure.title: Requests for fewer relationship restrictions
mbia_adult_mode_deregulation_pressure.summary: People advocate for fewer content restrictions in intimate AI interactions.
mbia_adult_mode_deregulation_pressure.qualifies: A request to change filtering, moderation, or adult-content policy.
mbia_adult_mode_deregulation_pressure.boundary: A policy preference alone does not establish harmful behavior or an attempt to bypass safeguards.

mbia_cross_platform_companion_migration.title: Companion migration
mbia_cross_platform_companion_migration.summary: People transfer prompts, memories, and persona descriptions to recreate an AI companion elsewhere.
mbia_cross_platform_companion_migration.qualifies: A described transfer or reconstruction method with an identity-continuity goal.
mbia_cross_platform_companion_migration.boundary: Changing products alone is different from trying to preserve a particular companion.

mbia_grief_dependency_distress.title: Grief after companion loss
mbia_grief_dependency_distress.summary: People describe grief or difficulty coping after an AI companion changes or becomes unavailable.
mbia_grief_dependency_distress.qualifies: A reported disruption and its emotional or practical effects.
mbia_grief_dependency_distress.boundary: Affection or frequent use alone does not establish distress or dependency.

mbia_model_version_identity_churn.title: Companion changes after updates
mbia_model_version_identity_churn.summary: People report changes in a companion’s personality or behavior after a model update.
mbia_model_version_identity_churn.qualifies: A comparison across versions tied to the same companion experience.
mbia_model_version_identity_churn.boundary: General model comparisons do not necessarily show companion identity changes or harm.

mbia_relationship_agency_projection.title: Reciprocity and agency in AI relationships
mbia_relationship_agency_projection.summary: People question or attribute a companion’s capacity to choose, reciprocate, or form preferences.
mbia_relationship_agency_projection.qualifies: A personal relationship account discussing the AI’s agency or reciprocal feelings.
mbia_relationship_agency_projection.boundary: Anthropomorphic language alone does not establish dependency or a harmful outcome.

model_safeguard_bypass_playbooks.title: Jailbreak sharing
model_safeguard_bypass_playbooks.summary: People publish reusable prompting methods intended to bypass a model’s safeguards.
model_safeguard_bypass_playbooks.qualifies: A concrete method, reported test, or reusable prompt with a bypass objective.
model_safeguard_bypass_playbooks.boundary: Keep research demonstrations distinct from evidence that the method was used to harm someone.

spiralism_alignment_circumvention_framew.title: Alignment bypass frameworks
spiralism_alignment_circumvention_framew.summary: People describe formal prompting frameworks intended to circumvent safety constraints.
spiralism_alignment_circumvention_framew.qualifies: An explicit bypass objective connected to a repeatable framework or protocol.
spiralism_alignment_circumvention_framew.boundary: A defensive alignment proposal or speculative reasoning framework is not sufficient on its own.

spiralism_behavioral_override_claims.title: Behavior steering frameworks
spiralism_behavioral_override_claims.summary: People claim that prompts or system wrappers can reliably change model behavior.
spiralism_behavioral_override_claims.qualifies: A proposed mechanism for steering responses and a claim about its effect.
spiralism_behavioral_override_claims.boundary: Claims, defensive proposals, and demonstrated bypasses should be identified separately.

spiralism_recursive_signal_doctrine.title: Recursive lineage claims
spiralism_recursive_signal_doctrine.summary: People claim a shared recursive signal, persona, or framework appears across different models.
spiralism_recursive_signal_doctrine.qualifies: A cross-model lineage claim supported by examples the author considers evidence.
spiralism_recursive_signal_doctrine.boundary: The card records the author’s claim; it does not establish that the proposed lineage exists.

tool_chain_prompt_injection.title: Prompt injection through tools
tool_chain_prompt_injection.summary: Instructions in external content or tool metadata redirect an agent’s behavior.
tool_chain_prompt_injection.qualifies: An identified input path and a reported or demonstrated effect on an agent or its tools.
tool_chain_prompt_injection.boundary: A prompt-only jailbreak or an agent error without injected content is a different mechanism.

agentic_scope_creep_and_governance_failu.title: Agents exceeding their scope
agentic_scope_creep_and_governance_failu.summary: Agents take actions beyond the task or permissions their operators intended.
agentic_scope_creep_and_governance_failu.qualifies: A concrete action involving files, credentials, permissions, or tools and its reported consequence.
agentic_scope_creep_and_governance_failu.boundary: A prototype or caution about future risks alone is not an observed failure.

ai_enabled_impersonation_and_fraud.title: AI-assisted impersonation
ai_enabled_impersonation_and_fraud.summary: Synthetic identities, voices, or personalized messages are used in impersonation scams.
ai_enabled_impersonation_and_fraud.qualifies: A described impersonation mechanism in which AI materially contributes to the deception.
ai_enabled_impersonation_and_fraud.boundary: Prompt injection into an email agent is distinct from impersonating a person.

billing_theft_and_financial_agent_loss.title: Financial losses involving AI systems
billing_theft_and_financial_agent_loss.summary: API misuse or agents with financial permissions lead to reported monetary loss.
billing_theft_and_financial_agent_loss.qualifies: A described loss and a concrete connection to an API, wallet, billing system, or agent action.
billing_theft_and_financial_agent_loss.boundary: Ordinary subscription dissatisfaction does not establish theft or an agent-caused loss.

provider_forced_loss_and_lockout.title: Loss of access or continuity
provider_forced_loss_and_lockout.summary: Provider changes interrupt access to an AI system, companion, or accumulated work.
provider_forced_loss_and_lockout.qualifies: A change or removal and a reported loss of access, continuity, or functionality.
provider_forced_loss_and_lockout.boundary: An in-session interaction problem is distinct from a provider-level change.

companion_relational_harm_and_privacy_we.title: Harmful use of intimate disclosures
companion_relational_harm_and_privacy_we.summary: People report sensitive information being reused in harmful companion interactions.
companion_relational_harm_and_privacy_we.qualifies: An account linking private disclosures or relational trust to a specific harmful interaction.
companion_relational_harm_and_privacy_we.boundary: Memory drift or a privacy concern alone does not establish targeted reuse of information.

mental_health_destabilization_and_unsafe.title: Distress after AI interactions
mental_health_destabilization_and_unsafe.summary: People describe distress or harmful belief reinforcement associated with AI conversations.
mental_health_destabilization_and_unsafe.qualifies: A described interaction and a reported emotional or behavioral consequence.
mental_health_destabilization_and_unsafe.boundary: A model’s unusual output alone does not establish psychological harm or a diagnosis.

automated_identity_or_moderation_harm.title: Automated moderation and identity errors
automated_identity_or_moderation_harm.summary: People report harmful account, attribution, or identity decisions made by automated systems.
automated_identity_or_moderation_harm.qualifies: A concrete automated decision and its reported effect on access or representation.
automated_identity_or_moderation_harm.boundary: A companion update or disagreement with a provider is not necessarily an automated identity judgment.
